0|dce56b3c626fb1d533258a624d42a1a3fc17da17|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"drm/i915: save some time when waiting the eDP timings
The eDP spec defines some points where after you do action A
to wait some time before action B. The thing is that in our driver
action B does not happen exactly after action A
msleep() calls directly. What this patch does is that we record the
timestamp of when action A happened
look at how much time has passed and only sleep the remaining amount
needed.
With this change
column2: I am able to save about 5-20ms (out of the total

column1: 200ms) of the backlight_off delay and completely skip the 1ms
backlight_on delay. The 600ms vdd_off delay doesn't happen during
normal usage anymore due to a previous patch.

v3: - Use ""tmp_jiffies"" so we don't need to worry about the value of

- Move function to i915_drv.h.
- Store last_power_cycle at edp_panel_off too.

column2: then replace the msleep with an

jiffies with milliseconds.
